item.description: [Climate & Environment] Keyword: climate change — A new review involving researchers at Umeå University has revealed the critical role that plant roots play in shaping how Arctic tundra ecosystems respond to climate change. item.title: New diabetes implant uses electricity to lower blood sugar and promote weight loss
item.description: [Diabetes & Kidney Disease] Keyword: type 2 diabetes — Researchers have developed a remarkable new electronic implant that could transform type 2 diabetes treatment by lowering blood sugar without insulin or traditional drugs. The device uses a special electrically powered catalyst to convert excess glucose into a substance that the body eliminates through urine, potentially preventing unwanted energy from being stored as fat. In diabetic mice, the implant precisely controlled blood sugar and promoted weight loss.
